description: This Java class provides a centralized configuration utility for API tests in the project. It reads configuration values from system properties, a .env file, environment variables, or defaults, facilitating flexible test configuration management.

classes.name: TestConfig
classes.description: A utility class for managing API test configuration settings with layered sourcing from system properties, env files, os environment variables, and defaults.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration value associated with a key, checking system properties, .env file, environment variables, and finally returning a default if none are set.

methods.name: baseUrl
methods.description: Returns the base URL for API calls, configurable via environment.

methods.name: apiBasePath
methods.description: Provides the API base path segment for requests.

methods.name: adminUsername
methods.description: Returns the administrator username for API authentication.

methods.name: adminPassword
methods.description: Returns the administrator password for API authentication.

methods.name: essUsername
methods.description: Returns the ESS user username for API authentication.

methods.name: essPassword
methods.description: Returns the ESS user password for API authentication.
